remarks: Welcome to this elegant and stunning end unit in the Kensett community. It offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and every modern convenience. This light-filled 4556sf home has many custom finishes accentuated with 10' ceilings, high-end moldings, glass transoms and white oak plank floors. The open floor plan flows seamlessly from one room to the next, and includes an elevator for easy living. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream featuring gorgeous cabinetry, quartzite countertops, high-end appliances and an oversized pantry--the perfect set up for entertainment and enjoyment. The primary suite has 2, large walk-in closets, a newly renovated primary bath with separate vanities, with a stand-alone tub and shower. The additional 2 bedrooms, on the second floor, are ensuite. This unit also boasts a large laundry room with new cabinetry and a new washer and dryer. The lower level is complete with a rec room/playroom, an additional bedroom with a full bath and a workspace! Step outside to a private stone terrace and lush property for your relaxation and enjoyment. Kensett offers a beautiful clubhouse with a built-in Gunite pool, gym, and nature/walking trails. This home provides unparalleled luxury and simple living at its very best.
